simulation_requirement: Based on the provided documents regarding DBS's record profits and the subsequent 13% pay increase for CEO Piyush Gupta, simulate a swarm of 10 diverse personas (e.g., a retail banking customer, a trade union representative, a shareholder, a financial analyst, and a low-income worker). Predict the dominant public sentiment on Singapore social media over the next 7 days. Specifically, forecast whether the reaction will result in a measurable 'reputational risk' score (1-10) and identify the primary 'point of anger' the public will fixate on.

initial_posts.content: DBS CEO pay rises to S$15.38 million after bank makes record S$8.19 billion net profit. A 13.3% increase from 2021. Read more on Mothership.
Our record performance in 2022 is a testament to our resilience and commitment to Asia. We are proud to be named World's Best Bank by Global Finance.
I just published a breakdown of Mr. Piyush Gupta's remuneration. It includes salary, cash bonuses, and deferred components. What are your thoughts on these figures?
While the bank celebrates $8 billion in profit, my home loan interest rates keep climbing. Is this where our money is going? To fund a $15m salary?
Record profits should mean better benefits for all employees, not just the top 1%. Our low-wage workers are struggling with 6% inflation while the CEO gets a 13% raise.
From an investment perspective, Gupta has delivered exceptional value. DBS is the only SG company in the Top 100 Best Workplaces for Innovators. Talent comes at a price.
Grateful for the team's hard work in a challenging year marked by high inflation and bearish markets. We continue to focus on sustainability and innovation.
DBS Foundation has committed S$5.6 million to financial literacy and food waste. We are building a more inclusive society.
Wait, the foundation gets $5.6m for the whole of Asia, but one man gets $15.38m for himself? The optics of this are terrible.
DBS continues to set the standard for banking excellence globally. Their 20% profit growth justifies the performance-based pay structure for leadership.

event_config.narrative_direction: 舆论将从最初的新闻事实报道，迅速演变为关于‘贫富差距’和‘通胀压力’的社会辩论。公众关注点将集中在：在普通民众面临生活成本危机和高通胀的背景下，CEO获得1500万新元的高薪是否具有道德合理性。尽管金融圈和股东可能支持基于业绩的奖励，但社交媒体上的主流情绪将趋向负面，认为银行在‘榨取普通客户’以奖励高管。预计声誉风险分数为7.8，主要愤怒点在于‘CEO的巨额涨薪与普通家庭面临的通胀压力之间的鲜明对比’。

generation_reasoning: 时间配置: 该事件涉及银行巨额利润与高管巨额加薪的强烈对比，在通胀背景下极具社会敏感性。模拟时长设为7天（168小时）以完整观察从新闻爆发到社会情绪发酵及后续声誉风险演变。活跃度配置符合中国网民习惯：上午9-11点为专业人士（分析师、股东）关注财报的高峰，而晚间19-22点则是普通民众（低收入者、零售客户）在社交媒体表达不满和固定情绪的最高峰。声誉风险预计在48-72小时内达到峰值，主要愤怒点将集中在‘通胀压力下银行利润与平民生活负担的贫富差距’。 | 事件配置: 该配置模拟了从官方媒体报道到各利益相关方（银行、CEO、分析师、普通员工及客户）的多维反应。重点突出了‘业绩成功’与‘社会公平’之间的矛盾。poster_type 严格遵循了提供的实体类型：mothership/Global Finance/DBS Foundation/Union 归类为 Organization；Piyush Gupta 归类为 Executive；DBS Group 归类为 CommercialBank；Winnie Li 及普通民众/分析师归类为 Person。 | Agent配置: 成功生成 7 个 | 初始帖子分配: 10 个帖子已分配发布者
